narr: Tropical Storm Elsa moved through central North Carolina during the daytime hours of Thursday, July 8. Widespread rainfall ranging from 2-5 inches affected areas along Highway US-1, with lesser amounts across the Coastal Plain and only a few tenths of an inch around the Greensboro and Winston-Salem areas. A few storms produced transient circulations capable of producing tornadoes. One report of flash flooding occurred as a result of Elsa.
ev: The intersection of Purnell Rd and Jackson Rd in Wake Forest was closed briefly due to flash flooding.
lsr: ROAD WAS CLOSED AT 4:32 PM AT THE INTERSECTION OF PURNELL RD AND JACKSON RD IN WAKE FOREST DUE TO FLASH FLOODING. THE ROAD IS NOW PASSABLE BUT CAUTION IS ADVISED.
